# Vendored Playwright

Copied unchanged from https://github.com/microsoft/playwright at commit `26137face0500cacddf90c767dc1364da7262559` by
`NEO_PLAYWRIGHT=<checkout> cargo test -p neo-runtime --test provenance -- --ignored sync`,
which generated this file. Do not edit anything here: `cargo test -p neo-runtime --test
provenance` fails on any edit, addition or removal.

The files are the Playwright sources that the neo crates' provenance lines cite and no
other neo vendor tree holds, at their paths in Playwright's repository, plus its LICENSE
and NOTICE.
